component.name: Rune
component.summary: A word processor that writes with you

description.p: Rune is an ODF-first word processor with the AI built into the page, not bolted on in a sidebar. Open, write, format and save documents, then have the AI correct, rewrite or continue them in place, one undo step at a time.

ul.li: Edits .odt natively; opens and saves .docx and .doc through LibreOffice, if it is installed
Styles, lists, tables, pages, headers and footers with page numbers
An outline, story notes, sources and citations beside the document
Sign in with a ChatGPT plan or with OpenRouter (Claude, GPT, Grok); sign-ins stay in the desktop keyring

description.p: Made for Omarchy, where it follows the desktop theme, and at home on any Linux desktop, where it follows the light or dark setting.
